title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Blueberry Raspberries Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Blueberry Raspberries delivers a perfect balance of ripe, sweet blueberries and tart, juicy raspberries for a vibrant fruity vape. Each pod pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, offering extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Equipped with advanced dual mesh coil technology, these pods ensure smooth, consistent flavour and dense vapour production. The innovative automatic refill system and leak-resistant design make refilling quick, easy, and mess-free. Together, the pod and refill container deliver up to 6000 puffs of Crystal’s vibrant, flavour-packed satisfaction, making it ideal for vapers who value long-lasting performance and convenience. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods provide a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief, making them a great choice for both experienced and newer adult vapers. Simply replace the used pod and refill container when empty to enjoy an uninterrupted, flavourful vaping experience.
